name: Hasnain Product Card Customizer & Slider for Elementor
author: hasnain92

sections.description:
Product Card Customizer and Slider for Elementor is a powerful addon designed for shop owners who want to stand out. Forget boring product grids—add 3D flip effects, staggered scroll reveals, and high-performance sliders to your store in minutes.

Key Features:

  • 6 Products Per Row: Perfect for large inventories.
  • Pro Slider Mode: Smooth auto-sliding with speed control (Powered by Swiper.js).
  • 20+ Modern Animations: 3D Tilt, Glossy Shine, Border-draw, and more.
  • Staggered Scroll Reveal: Cards appear one-by-one as you scroll.
  • Category Wise Filtering: Show all products or pick a specific category.
  • Deep Customization: Control colors, price sizing, and button padding directly in Elementor.
  • Performance First: Lightweight Vanilla JS, no bloat, conditional loading.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the .zip file via the WordPress ‘Add New’ plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any Elementor page and search for the ‘Product Card Customizer and Slider for Elementor’ widget.
  4. Drag, drop, and start customizing!
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added 20+ animations and Swiper.js slider support.
  • Added Category-based product filtering.
